last_assistant_message:
A Stop hook gets the fields every hook gets (`session_id`, `prompt_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `scratchpad_dir`, `permission_mode`, `effort` and `hook_event_name`) plus four of its own: `stop_hook_active`, `last_assistant_message`, `background_tasks` and `session_crons`. `stop_hook_active` is true when Claude is already continuing because of an earlier Stop hook, `last_assistant_message` holds the text of Claude's final response, and the two arrays list background tasks still running and scheduled wakeups, so a hook can tell a finished session from one waiting on background work.

I read all six files in full, but in more pieces than the paste asked for: the Read tool caps each call at 25k tokens, so `hooks.txt` took four reads instead of three, `DISPOSITIONS.md` two, and `Aim.md` (345 KB) eight.
